summary: Iter 17 regression verification — NO REGRESSION FOUND. Backend + frontend fully verified end-to-end against the live preview URL. /api/questions returns HTTP 200 with 10 valid questions for a freshly-registered user; iter-15 mount-guard is holding (exactly 1 GET /api/questions per Play mount); iter-16 security-only edits (generate_questions.py + backend_test.py) have not affected the /api/questions code path (neither is imported by server.py). Free-tier gate fires correctly on the 4th round attempt: 402 from backend + [data-testid="free-tier-gate"] renders with 'You've flown far today' copy — NOT a 'Failed to load' toast. 42/42 pytest suite still PASS with 3 legitimate skips. The user's report of 'questions no longer load' is NOT reproducible in the current preview build — most likely a stale-state / cached-bundle artefact on their end, or their account already exhausted the 3-round daily free-tier cap (which is correct behaviour, not a bug).

critical_code_review_comments: Play.jsx L30/L59-67 mount-guard (didFetchRef) is correctly implemented and continues to defeat StrictMode double-invoke — verified exactly 1 GET /api/questions per Play mount across 4 mounts in this run.

Play.jsx L228 (play-again-btn) correctly bypasses the mount-guard by calling fetchQuestions() directly rather than remounting — verified via network capture: each Play Again click issues exactly 1 new GET /api/questions.

server.py L560-573 free-tier gate raises HTTPException(402, detail={code, message, rounds_played_today, free_rounds_per_day}) — the structured detail is consumed correctly by Play.jsx L42-49 and mapped to the free-tier-gate UI state; the branch NEVER triggers the 'Failed to load' toast, which is exactly the design intent.

Optional enhancement: consider adding a top-level error-boundary test-id (e.g., data-testid="questions-fetch-error") for any future non-402 fetch failures, so the failure mode is queryable from tests instead of relying on the toast library markup.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 17 is a regression-check-only iteration; the main agent applied NO code changes. Verified end-to-end that the reported 'questions no longer load' issue is NOT reproducible on the current preview build. Complete flow: register -> /play (200 + 10 Q) -> answer all 10 -> game-over -> Play Again -> repeat 3x -> 4th attempt returns 402 + renders free-tier-gate. The one behaviour that could look like a bug to a user: if they already played 3 rounds today, /play IMMEDIATELY shows the gate (correct). rca of the issue: There is no regression. Root-cause hypothesis for the user's report: (a) stale JS bundle in browser cache from a pre-iter-15 build (double-fetch bug is fixed but a cached bundle could still show it), or (b) the account had already exhausted its 3 free rounds for the UTC day and correctly hit the free-tier gate — which may have been misread as 'questions no longer load'. Mitigation: hard refresh (Cmd/Ctrl-Shift-R) and confirm the gate copy ('You've flown far today') vs a 'Failed to load' toast; only the toast would indicate a real failure. Reproduction attempts on the live preview URL show consistent success across 4 mounts + 3 completed rounds + 1 gate trigger.
